verdict.rationale: Apple's own docs confirm the M4 family has a faster Neural Engine, and Apple ships official ML SDKs today: Core ML, MLX (with GPU Neural Accelerators support) and Metal/MPS Graph. However, the evidence never gives a published TOPS figure or its precision, and never explicitly ties Core ML to the Neural Engine. missing for 10: published Neural Engine TOPS figure, stated precision (e.g. INT8/FP16), explicit documentation that Core ML targets the Neural Engine on M4 Pro, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the chip's AI acceleration is exposed to developers — an NPU or neural engine with a published TOPS figure (precision stated) and an official SDK or runtime that ships today

citations.quote: This, combined with the faster Neural Engine of the M4 family, means on-device Apple Intelligence models run at blazing speed.
Core ML delivers fast performance for integrating traditional machine learning models into your apps and games
MLX is an open-source array framework that lets you experiment with, training, researching, and fine-tuning generative models on Apple Silicon.
It supports Metal 4 and GPU Neural Accelerators for maximum performance
